fairUse.rationale: Small image of the publisher’s illustrated rulebook cover identifies the exact game and rules edition discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Rendered page 1 of the official publisher rules PDF https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-daysofwonder/uploads/2024/07/rr_rules_2015_en.pdf. The illustrated title page visibly identifies this game and matches the linked rules edition; reduced to 266 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Start with whoever saw a relic most recently. If nobody in the group has ever seen a relic, use the most recent visit to a shrine or temple instead. Then take turns clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Choose the starting player before turning over the top tile of each purple temple.
